specialties.title: Specialties
specialties.description: Specialty keywords matched against NPI taxonomy descriptions, e.g. dentist, chiropractor, physical therapy, family medicine, pharmacy.

states.title: States (optional)
states.description: Two-letter US state codes, e.g. TX, CA, NY. Empty = all states.

cities.title: Cities (optional)
cities.description: City names, combined with each state if states are set.

postalCodes.title: ZIP codes (optional)
postalCodes.description: 5-digit ZIPs; a trailing * matches a prefix, e.g. 787* for all of Austin. Used instead of cities/states when set.

providerType.title: Provider type
providerType.description: Individual providers (doctors, dentists), organizations (practices, clinics, pharmacies), or both.

maxProviders.title: Max providers per run
maxProviders.description: Cap on provider rows returned. Controls total cost.

dedupe.title: Skip providers seen in previous runs
dedupe.description: Remember returned NPIs across runs and skip them. Turn on for scheduled prospecting.
